name: Hearing aids
summary: How expats navigate hearing aids in Singapore — audiology assessments, device trials, workplace listening needs, and funding / insurance realities.
body:
Hearing aid pathways usually start with an audiologist assessment and medical clearance when indicated. Device choice depends on hearing loss pattern, work environments, and dexterity for maintenance — not only price tiers.

## Decision points
- Audiology assessment vs ENT workup first
- RIC / BTE / custom form factors
- Trial periods and fine-tuning visits
- Streaming / meeting-room needs for office work
- Warranty, batteries/recharge, and loss cover

Bring a partner to history-taking when possible.

## How to choose
Prefer clinics that publish trial lengths and include follow-up fitting visits. Ask about noisy-restaurant programmes and remote adjustments. Avoid pressure to buy same-day without a trial.

## Practical tip
Test devices in your real commute and meeting rooms during the trial — not only the quiet fitting room.
